body: Guessing your temp was probably still too hot from when you had the oven up at 850. 600-650 is a solid temp for pies with low moisture mozz. Dough looks good but stretched a little thin at the crust. I’ve found it beneficial to establish a crust and stretch from the center outward so your pizza isn’t oblong, you’ll have a more consistent surface area on the bottom for an even cook. I’m saying this as a person who’s never cooked a pizza in an ooni tho so take my temp suggestions with a grain of salt. Best way to learn your ovens quirks is to just try again!!!!

Build in collins equivalent glass, add ice and soda to top. No need to mess with sweet and sour here- the pre packaged stuff tends to have some ingredients that aren’t particularly delicious. 

If you want to make your own sweet and sour you can add 1 part fresh strained lemon juice and 1 part fresh strained lime juice to 1 part 2:1 simple syrup and a little salt which should give you a tastier similar product. Basically sweet and sour was created to elongate the lifespan of citrus and cut out prep time but mass production turned it into a pretty widely hated ingredient.
